name: Color Hold
description: Removes all color except pixels close to a key color, which stay in color; the rest turns gray.

params.name: color
params.description: Color to keep; alpha is ignored

params.name: similarity
params.description: Distance from the key color that keeps its color; 0.01 matches only very close colors, 1 everything

params.name: blend
params.description: Width of the soft edge above the similarity; 0 = hard cut
